title: IE39002: Instrumentation Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Study of Hydraulic and Pneumatic Control Systems, Flow control system, Control
of time-delay system, PID controller tuning, A.C/ D.C servo systems. Optical
measurement System: Current and Voltage Measurement, Laser based dimensional
measurement, Lock-in amplifier. ECG monitoring system. Data acquisition and
Communication system.
